# Temple Scroll Column 65 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 65 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**65:1** The Levitical priests — the whole tribe of Levi — are to receive no land allotment or inheritance among Israel. They will live on the offerings made to the LORD by fire and on his share.

**65:2** They will have no inheritance among their fellow tribes; the LORD himself is their inheritance, just as he told them.

**65:3** This is what the priests are entitled to receive from the people whenever someone offers a sacrifice, whether cattle or sheep: the shoulder, both jawbones, and the stomach.

**65:4** You must also give the priest the first portion of your grain, new wine, and olive oil, and the first wool from the shearing of your flocks.

**65:5** For the LORD your God has singled him out from all your tribes to stand and serve in the LORD's name — he and his descendants — permanently.

**65:6** If a Levite moves from whatever town in Israel where he has been living and comes eagerly to the place I will choose,

**65:7** he may serve in the name of the LORD his God just like all the other Levites who serve there in my presence.

**65:8** He is to receive an equal share of the food, regardless of any income from selling family property.

**65:9** When you enter the land I am giving you, do not adopt the disgusting practices of the nations already there.

**65:10** No one among you is to sacrifice a son or daughter in fire, practice fortune-telling, read omens, interpret signs, engage in witchcraft,

**65:11** cast spells, consult mediums or spiritists, or try to communicate with the dead.

**65:12** Anyone who does these things is detestable to the LORD. It is precisely because of these practices that the LORD your God is driving those nations out ahead of you.

**65:13** You must be completely faithful to the LORD your God.

**65:14** The nations you are displacing consult fortune-tellers and diviners, but the LORD your God will not let you do that.

**65:15** Instead, the LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people, one of your own brothers. You must listen to him.

**65:16** This is what you yourselves asked for at Horeb on the day of the great assembly, when you said: Do not let us hear the voice of the LORD our God or see this tremendous fire again, or we will die.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 65 covers priestly rights and the famous prophet-like-Moses promise. The list of forbidden occult practices shows how seriously the Qumran community took the boundary between legitimate divine communication (through prophets) and illegitimate means (divination, necromancy). The prophet promise in 65:15 became one of the most cited messianic texts in early Judaism and Christianity — the community at Qumran was actively waiting for this figure.*
